competition.title: All the 50’s
competition.description: All the 50’s: 1,000 tickets, four £50 cash instant wins and a £100 main prize. Tickets cost 50p each. Closes 19 October 2026 at 8pm UK time.

requirements: Verify existing instant-win database schema and server allocation logic.
